changelog: Messages you send are the messages that arrive. Over-length messages are now refused before sending instead of being silently shortened, sends confirm the exact stored length, and reading a full thread shows the whole message — no more quiet truncation. Isolated identities (VIBE_HOME) stay fully separate.
features: vibe_dm and vibe_reply refuse an over-length message instead of trimming it, and show a receipt (id, stored length, server time) so a shortened send can never look successful
Reading a full conversation shows the entire message body, not the first 500 characters
VIBE_HOME isolation is real: an isolated session never reads or overwrites the shared identity, and an empty VIBE_HOME fails loudly instead of merging identities
